scope: versioned external research references; not ingest, API or independent scientific verification

methods.title: OpenAI research and deployment
methods.reportedFinding: Entry point to OpenAI's research, products and publications.
methods.transferablePattern: Use as a human-reviewed discovery route; do not infer API availability or scientific approval.
validationRequirements: Check destination publication date and original source
Capture article/DOI and author-level provenance
methods.limitations: Homepage changes over time and is not a licensed machine-readable research data source.

methods.title: Discrete geometry counterexample
methods.reportedFinding: An OpenAI reasoning model proposed a counterexample family for a longstanding unit-distance conjecture; external mathematicians checked the proof.
methods.transferablePattern: Apply proof-obligation and independent verification techniques to rigorous analytical claims and invariants; not a drug-discovery result.
validationRequirements: Independent mathematical verification
Reproducible symbolic claims with exact assumptions
Versioned counterexamples and proof artifacts
methods.limitations: A validated mathematics proof does not establish correctness of biological or clinical conclusions.

methods.title: Theoretical physics preprint
methods.reportedFinding: A model proposed a simplified theoretical-physics expression; authors checked and verified the derivation in a preprint.
methods.transferablePattern: Capture hypotheses, domain assumptions and independent analytical verification for simulation and model development.
validationRequirements: Explicit mathematical assumptions
Independent derivation and known-case checks
Preprint status and revision tracking
methods.limitations: The physics result is not a pharmacological model and the preprint's claims must not be inherited by NovaPharm.

methods.title: Medicinal chemistry, AI and laboratory validation
methods.reportedFinding: GPT-5.4 and Molecule.one Maria explored a medicinal-chemistry research question in high-throughput experiments; humans guided the study and replicated representative findings at bench scale.
methods.transferablePattern: Model a non-executing hypothesis-to-proposal-to-evidence-to-independent-replication lifecycle for qualified internal chemists.
validationRequirements: Qualified chemist approval and lab safety review
Independent replication and scope limits
Source provenance, variability and scale transfer assessment
methods.limitations: Reported results cover particular reaction classes and experiments; they do not authorize autonomous chemical synthesis, production transfer or general-yield claims.

methods.title: Cell-free protein synthesis optimization
methods.reportedFinding: In a collaboration with Ginkgo Bioworks, GPT-5-assisted laboratory iteration was associated with a 40% reduction in protein-production cost in a studied cell-free system.
methods.transferablePattern: Design research evaluation around comparable cost baselines, measured outputs, change control and qualified lab review.
validationRequirements: Independent cost-accounting denominator
Replicate across proteins, conditions and scale
Review dataset provenance and lab experiment authority
methods.limitations: The result was reported for one protein and one cell-free system; no NovaPharm cost saving or general manufacturing benefit has been demonstrated.

methods.title: Immunology hypothesis investigation
methods.reportedFinding: GPT-5 Pro helped an immunologist develop a plausible explanation of unexpected T-cell experiment outcomes, illustrating human-led mechanism investigation.
methods.transferablePattern: Maintain alternative hypotheses, expert plausibility review and disconfirming evidence before making biological inferences.
validationRequirements: Independent mechanism evidence
Expert review and controlled validation
Separate inference from biological or clinical fact
methods.limitations: This is a reported research account, not an independently validated NovaPharm immunology model or a therapy claim.

methods.title: Rare-disease expert-led reanalysis
methods.reportedFinding: An AI-assisted reanalysis of 376 previously unsolved cases produced leads that physicians later confirmed in 18 cases after expert review and testing.
methods.transferablePattern: Support non-patient-facing literature/gene-disease evidence crosswalk planning and periodic knowledge-refresh methodology, without ingesting clinical records.
validationRequirements: Ethics, privacy and legal approval for any future clinical data
Physician-led confirmation and independent clinical validation
Prospective performance evaluation and false-positive analysis
methods.limitations: The model generated leads rather than making diagnoses; NovaPharm has no authorized patient-data or diagnostic service.

methods.title: Codex-supported scientific simulation
methods.reportedFinding: An astrophysics researcher used Codex to explore and test simulation algorithms against known physical solutions.
methods.transferablePattern: Apply reproducible software experiments, numerical regression tests and model-to-reference comparisons in non-clinical pharmaceutical analytics.
validationRequirements: Deterministic fixtures and independent code review
Known-solution/holdout testing and convergence evidence
Security, dependency and reproducibility checks
methods.limitations: An algorithm working for an astrophysical simulation is not evidence of validity for drug modelling, clinical prediction or pharmacy outcomes.

methods.title: OpenAI Science news index
methods.reportedFinding: Editorial index of scientific reports and researcher perspectives, observed on 18 November 2026.
methods.transferablePattern: Use as a manually reviewed discovery source; record individual publication versions before adding new case studies.
validationRequirements: Explicit human review of each dated article
Source attribution and individual evidence maturity
Do not infer current data from the last catalogue snapshot
methods.limitations: This is not an approved real-time API, live web feed or continuously monitored source.
